t: The Rotor Shaft is the main component of the Turbine $(l:bigreactors:turbine/rotor)Rotor$(/l)$(br2)The Rotor Shaft blocks must be placed one after the other inside the Turbine and must encompass its entire length, starting from the $(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-rotorbearing)Rotor Bearing$(/l) and ending against a $(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-casing)Housing$(/l) block on the other side.$(br2)

转子轴是涡轮机$(l:bigreactors:turbine/rotor)转子$(/l)$(br2)的核心组件。转子轴方块必须在涡轮机内部首尾相接依次放置，并须覆盖整个涡轮机长度——起始于$(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-rotorbearing)转子轴承$(/l)，终止于另一端的$(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-casing)外壳$(/l)方块。$(br2)
